integrity: Analytic necessary-and-sufficient proof supplied; finite numerical checks are supportive, not an infinite proof. Prior forward formulas and Gaussian limits are acknowledged; independent validation is absent.
limitations: Identical independent symmetric stationary Markov telegraphs, equal coupling, common rate, and a covariance-matched stationary Gaussian OU comparator only; no claim for asymmetric or nonstationary baths or finite-observation experiments.
title: A sharp all-time Gaussian envelope threshold for finite telegraph dephasing baths
